items.title: ‘Mayday, mayday.’ A flight from Texas to the Bahamas ended in tragedy. What investigators are examining
items.brief: It took about 90 seconds for a routine report of ice and turbulence to be replaced by a desperate “Mayday, mayday!” and then silence, as a private jet plunged more than 27,000 feet over the course of one minute…

items.title: Google will let schools turn off AI, but they may also lose Search
items.brief: Google is rolling out new controls for schools to limit students’ access to the company’s AI tools.

items.title: Convicted murderer who escaped through Tennessee prison fence is captured, officials say
items.brief: A convicted murderer who escaped a Tennessee jail was apprehended in Missouri and brought back into custody, officials said –– nine days after he breached the prison fence and drove off in a stolen truck.

items.title: Spanish transport minister resigns after two deadly train crashes in one year
items.brief: Spain’s Minister of Transport Óscar Puente announced his resignation after two deadly train crashes occurred in a single year, including one last week that killed 69 people and injured more than 200.

items.title: Trump’s Election Day bombshell on Israel points to historic shift in US politics
items.brief: President Donald Trump is arguably the most pro-Israel president of modern times.

items.title: Storm soaks central US on Election Day after causing deadly flooding, voting disruptions in Southwest
items.brief: Widespread rain draped across the central United States on Election Day from the same storm that caused deadly and historic flooding in the Southwest over the past few days.
